faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Mangalagiri (AIIMS Mangalagiri) for filling up project positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Senior Resident/Consultant under the Tele MANAS project on a contract basis for healthcare services.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Resident/Consultant post under this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the Senior Resident/Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a post-graduate Psychiatry qualification such as an MD or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Senior Resident/Consultant position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 1,00,000/- for the duration of the contract.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application via email?
faq.answer: The last date to upload and submit the soft copies of the filled application form and required documents via email is 07-11-2026.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 10-11-2026 at the Administration Block, AIIMS Mangalagiri, and candidates should report by 8:00 AM.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications via email to [email protected] followed by attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website for AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the institute at www.aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in for further updates and detailed notification.
